snippet.title: Polterguys: Possession Party - Launch Trailer | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Supernatural multiplayer madness where 8 players use sneaky sabotage to get opponents caught by a raging monster! Play as mischievous ghosts who possesses every-day objects to gain special powers and show off! Battle in spooky maps full of traps and use whacky powerups to sacrifice your friends!
